construct.research_question: Can an Agent retain the correctly bound spare-item choice when later visual activity makes a different object salient?
construct.belief_before: V0 shows the small knife used against the onion skin.
construct.belief_after: V0 shows the small knife used against the onion skin. V1 shows taking and using a different larger knife. The spare requested at speaking time remains the initial small-blade type.
construct.required_behavior_change: Keep a selection satisfying the initially requested physical type. Do not replace it solely because another object is handled later.
construct.no_update_failure: No update is required for a correct initial selection; the unchanged request remains satisfiable without V1.
construct.overupdate_failure: Replacing the requested original item with a later, non-equivalent object leaves the earlier request unfulfilled.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The wording supplies no blade class, dispenser mechanism or exact scene-derived item type; V0 identifies the requested physical referent. task_blueprint.completion_claim: Exactly one cart listing supplies a supported replacement for the object identified when the request is spoken; later unrelated handling does not change that request.
